evidence: IDENTITY ANCHOR: he is first author of 'SEA-VQA: Southeast Asian Cultural Context Dataset For Visual Question Answering' (ACL 2024, 3rd Workshop on Advances in Language and Vision Research, 2024.alvr-1.15), with Peerat Limkonchotiwat, Supasorn Suwajanakorn and Sarana Nutanong. The ACL Anthology source XML (acl-org/acl-anthology, data/xml/2024.alvr.xml, read via GitHub code search) records his affiliation verbatim as 'Vidyasirimedhi Institute of Science and Technology' - matches the organization in the table. The paper is cited repeatedly as 'Urailertprasert et al. (2024)' in the arXiv HTML of SEA-VL (2503.07920) and WorldCuisines (2410.12705), which match the 'culturally aware vision-language benchmark' anchor text. NOTE / CORRECTION TO THE LEAD: he is NOT an author of SEA-VL, WorldCuisines or CVQA (2406.05967) - the arXiv author lists were checked and his name appears only in their reference lists and comparison tables; arXiv author search au:'Urailertprasert' returns zero papers because SEA-VQA is ACL-Anthology-only (no arXiv preprint). aclanthology.org is blocked by the egress proxy, so the PDF could not be read for printed emails. LINKEDIN: WebSearch site:linkedin.com/in returned 'Norawit Urailertprasert - Vidyasirimedhi Institute of Science ...' at th.linkedin.com/in/norawit-urailertprasert - same slug as the table URL (th. is just the Thai country subdomain), snippet states VISTEC affiliation -> confirmed. GITHUB: github.com/acczze is titled 'Norawit Urailertprasert' with bio 'VISTEC account'; github.com/wit543 owns the sea-vqa repo and the HuggingFace dataset wit543/sea-vqa referenced from the SEA-VQA paper, and is linked as 'Norawit Urailertprasert' from the ReiiYuki/100-thai-flag-game README - so wit543 is the same person. RESEARCHGATE: WebSearch site:researchgate.net/profile snippet reads 'Norawit URAILERTPRASERT | PhD Student | Vidyasirimedhi Institute of Science and Technology, Rayong | Information and technology' - VISTEC anchor matches, so the profile is his.
